For more information and to order imagery products please refer to the GEO Stereo Imagery Order Form.

  • Time of Capture: March 18th - April 29th 2010 
  • Number of Frames: 70,521 frames 
  • Resolution: 20 centimetre (Panchromatic) or 40cm (RGBN)
  • Bit-depth: 16-bit 
  • Number of bands: Single band (Panchromatic) or Four band (RGBN) 
  • Format: TIFF (ISAT AT model setup) 

For more information on the South Western Ontario Orthophotography Project (SWOOP) 2010 please see the main SWOOP 2010 GeoHub record. 

 
Available Products: 
Stereo Frames 
  • South Western Ontario Orthophotography Project (SWOOP) 2010 - Stereo Frames and associated AT Models 

Contact Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources - Geospatial Ontario, imagery@ontario.ca
